_comment: garden_walkthrough's fixture: standing at the inn bed (2,6 facing DOWN onto 2,7), ready for the qualifying sleep. Act III fully reached (near_act3 precedent: warrior 5 + a SECOND class already held so reached_two_classes derives on Continue -- tactician 1; 3 completed quests via the_errand/missing_crate/cisterns, same accomplishment set as near_act3). ISSUE #123 REDESIGN: [Helper] is NO LONGER pre-held -- the old shape (helper:1 with cleaned_the_inn:0, its own gained_by, banked live by the script's Kth-leg clean) was a story-impossible position, grandfathered in test_fixture_coherence's CLASS_REQUIREMENTS_EXEMPT until this redesign removed it. The script's live dirty_table clean now feeds a REAL [Helper] grant at the qualifying sleep (what an actual player at this position sees: '[Helper] class gained! — [Basic Cooking]' rides the sleep toast queue while garden_door_unlocked still banks silently underneath). warrior:5 is honest per the same validator: sparred_with_relc:1 (gained_by) + won_combat:1 (L2) + melee_hit:18 (L5's exact threshold; L6 needs 25, so no spurious level-up rides the sleep) -- near_act3's own warrior-5 counter template. watch_runner_pointed is PRE-BANKED (unlike near_act3, which leaves it for arc_flow to fire live). `tactician: 1` is honestly earned (chess_with_olesm:1 banked, its gained_by; L1 has no requires) so [Appraise Foe] (`observe`) is known from load, needed live by garden_walkthrough's memorial-hill appraisal beat -- and the two live appraisals only reach observed_things:2, under L2's 3, so no tactician level-up rides the garden bed sleep either. One deliberate gap in this fixture: exactly K-1=1 of the ratified legs is PRE-banked here -- resolved_wrong_order (live, The Wrong Order) -- while the 2nd leg, cleaned_the_inn (ALSO Helper's own gained_by threshold, which is exactly why the class must NOT be pre-held), is left UNBANKED so garden_walkthrough earns it LIVE (a real dirty_table [Basic Cleaning] use) immediately before the qualifying sleep -- proving the Kth leg lands in-script, not merely pre-baked into the fixture. goblins_spared/sign_defended are deliberately ABSENT here (this run never took the goblin_parley 'Stand aside' branch or banked a sign-tied id) -- the fixture's K=2 stays exactly {resolved_wrong_order, cleaned_the_inn}, proving those two alone still clear the gate now that goblins_spared is a live third leg. gold 15 = the position ledger's Tier-3 honest income for this leg set (no warren bounty, no door-chain catalyst spend -- docs/design/fixture-position-ledger.md); equipped `relcs_spare_spear`, the tutorial gift an Act-III PC carries over the starter rusty_sword (warrior's own L1 grants both power_strike/piercing_strikes, so the kit is unaffected by the family swap). times_slept 6 (cosmetic, fewer story-sleeps than the door-chain family since this leg never touches the Raskghar arc). TRAP: rng_state is a properly-derived state (.seed=9, captured .state), never hand-typed -- WISave restores .state directly, not .seed. This fixture's own canonical never resolves a fight to completion off this rng_state, so its exact value is cosmetic/inert for outcome purposes.
